shared_constraints.new_dots: 100% on pinned ancestor ridge union H19-5|H19-4|H16-1, inside footprint, >3.0 px from catalogue, >=sqrt(8) px from every other dot (brief sec 4.4; R0 spacing floor never tightened)

arms.design: Disperse: donors are the lowest-unique-credit dots in the densest occupied 10 km blocks (density = dots / footprint cells, padded block grid); destinations are unused ridge cells in the sparsest occupied 10 km blocks (dest fraction fixed by the down8 capacity ladder, so down4 is a strict prefix of down8 in sources and destinations). R0 occupied-10 km density CV measured this session = 0.736 (canonical block_density_stats), above the 0.51-0.59 band, so a down move is the CV-band direction at this scale too.
arms.preregistered_prediction_model: +0.001 (band -0.002..+0.004); analog of concb5kmdown4 (+0.0015 MODEL, +0.0008 PROXY) with coarser, weaker targeting, so slightly smaller
arms.falsifier: Live delta <= -0.005 vs R0 falsifies fault-system-scale dispersal; then close the 10 km branch and keep concb5kmdown4 as the only CONCENTRATION slot candidate.

arms.design: Double dose of b10km-down4 (strict extension of the same source and destination orderings). Tests dose response and ridge-pool saturation in sparse 10 km blocks (only 8,761 free ridge cells exist anywhere >=sqrt(8) px from R0).
arms.preregistered_prediction_model: +0.001 (band -0.003..+0.005); sign expected to match down4 with attenuated per-dot yield
arms.falsifier: down8 live delta <= down4 live delta - 0.005 shows the sparse-block ridge pool is exhausted at 4% and caps any future dispersal dose.

arms.design: Sign control: concentrate toward the top-35% Faulds fault-interaction blocks with the prior recomputed at 100 px blocks (scale-matched halos: 30 km catalogue tip/junction halo, 10 km ridge tip/junction halo, same 0.40/0.30/0.30 weights and AGC TMI term as the 5 km session). Directly comparable to b5km-ridge-up8 (-0.0007 MODEL).
arms.preregistered_prediction_model: -0.001 (band -0.004..+0.002); upward concentration has lost at 1 km and 5 km on every instrument
arms.falsifier: Live delta >= +0.010 would falsify the dispersal preference and say fault-system-scale interaction zoning, not block-density equalisation, is the active lever.
